-- Explicit migration-owner operation, never applied by application startup.
-- Supply libpq connection settings privately in the environment, not command arguments.
-- psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f hosted/migrations/001_recipes.sql
-- Duplicate application deliberately fails rather than hiding schema drift.
-- No roles, extensions, public-schema changes, or existing-data modifications.
BEGIN;
CREATE SCHEMA meal_planner;
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA meal_planner FROM PUBLIC;
CREATE TABLE meal_planner.schema_migrations (
 version integer PRIMARY KEY,
 applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);
INSERT INTO meal_planner.schema_migrations (version) VALUES (1);
CREATE TABLE meal_planner.recipes (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_issuer text NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_issuer) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
 owner_subject text NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_subject) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
 revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
 status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'approved')),
 origin text NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('manual', 'agent')),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 content jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(content) = 'object'),
 UNIQUE (owner_issuer, owner_subject, id)
);
CREATE INDEX recipes_owner_page ON meal_planner.recipes (owner_issuer, owner_subject, id);
-- Immutable receipts return the original result even after subsequent edits.
-- Retain these for the recipe lifetime to preserve safe retries.
CREATE TABLE meal_planner.recipe_creates (
 owner_issuer text NOT NULL,
 owner_subject text NOT NULL,
 operation_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(operation_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
 request_hash bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_hash) = 32),
 recipe_id uuid NOT NULL,
 receipt jsonb NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (owner_issuer, owner_subject, operation_key),
 FOREIGN KEY (owner_issuer, owner_subject, recipe_id) REFERENCES meal_planner.recipes (owner_issuer, owner_subject, id)
);
CREATE TABLE meal_planner.recipe_updates (
 owner_issuer text NOT NULL,
 owner_subject text NOT NULL,
 recipe_id uuid NOT NULL,
 expected_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK (expected_revision > 0),
 request_hash bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_hash) = 32),
 receipt jsonb NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (owner_issuer, owner_subject, recipe_id, expected_revision),
 FOREIGN KEY (owner_issuer, owner_subject, recipe_id) REFERENCES meal_planner.recipes (owner_issuer, owner_subject, id)
);
REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA meal_planner FROM PUBLIC;
-- Separately grant the pre-provisioned runtime role USAGE on this schema,
-- SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on recipes, SELECT/INSERT on both receipt tables.
-- Runtime must not own this schema or have CREATE, DELETE, or migration rights.
COMMIT;
files.hosted/migrations/004_draft_ingest.sql:
-- Reviewed migration-owner operation only. Never run by application startup.
-- Preview only: no credential creation, no runtime grants, no existing data edits.
-- Duplicate application deliberately fails. This slice has no purge/retention job.
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE public.draft_ingest_grants (
 token_hash bytea PRIMARY KEY CHECK (octet_length(token_hash)=32),
 environment text NOT NULL CHECK (environment='preview'),
 owner_issuer text NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_issuer) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
 owner_subject text NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_subject) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
 email_at_approval text NOT NULL CHECK (length(email_at_approval) BETWEEN 1 AND 254),
 scope text NOT NULL CHECK (scope='draft:create'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 revoked_at timestamptz,
 last_used_at timestamptz,
 CHECK (expires_at>created_at AND expires_at<=created_at+interval '7 days')
);
CREATE TABLE public.draft_ingest_submissions (
 environment text NOT NULL CHECK (environment='preview'),
 owner_issuer text NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_issuer) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
 owner_subject text NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_subject) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
 operation_key text NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(operation_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
 request_hash bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_hash)=32),
 -- Retained forever with receipt/key: deliberately no grant FK/cascade.
 originating_grant_hash bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(originating_grant_hash)=32),
 request json NOT NULL CHECK (json_typeof(request)='object'),
 response json NOT NULL CHECK (json_typeof(response)='object'),
 retained_bytes bigint NOT NULL CHECK (retained_bytes>0 AND retained_bytes<=16777216),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (environment,owner_issuer,owner_subject,operation_key),
 CHECK (retained_bytes >= octet_length(request::text)+octet_length(response::text)+octet_length(operation_key)+octet_length(environment)+octet_length(owner_issuer)+octet_length(owner_subject)+64+4096)
);
CREATE INDEX draft_ingest_owner_time ON public.draft_ingest_submissions (environment,owner_issuer,owner_subject,created_at);
REVOKE ALL ON public.draft_ingest_grants,public.draft_ingest_submissions FROM PUBLIC;
-- Separately provision a dedicated non-owner runtime role. Minimum privileges:
-- USAGE on public; SELECT on grants; UPDATE(last_used_at) on grants (FOR SHARE
-- needs an UPDATE privilege); SELECT, INSERT on submissions. Do not grant any
-- grant-issuance/revocation fields, UPDATE/DELETE on submissions, schema CREATE,
-- recipes, or auth tables. Revocation is an administrative UPDATE revoked_at;
-- it conflicts with the submit transaction's SHARE lock.
-- No automatic grant provisioning: pairing, active-grant quotas, membership epoch
-- invalidation and private credential delivery require their own reviewed slice.
COMMIT;
files.migrations/002_framebriar.sql:
-- Standalone Framebriar migration 002; it does not write the recipe-only
-- meal_planner.schema_migrations ledger. Record this file checksum separately.
-- Apply independently in Preview and Production, using separate databases and
-- credentials. The application never runs migrations or provisions storage.
-- No invitations, raw account identifiers, or feedback payloads belong here.
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE public.framebriar_enrollments (
    owner text PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(owner) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
    generation uuid NOT NULL,
    state text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(state) <= 32),
    key_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(key_id) <= 128),
    sealed bytea CHECK (octet_length(sealed) <= 32768),
    expires_at timestamptz,
    attempt text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(attempt) <= 128),
    attempt_at timestamptz,
    attempt_digest text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(attempt_digest) <= 64),
    cooldown_until timestamptz,
    rate_window timestamptz,
    rate_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rate_count >= 0),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
COMMENT ON TABLE public.framebriar_enrollments IS
 'Server-only encrypted Framebriar enrollment, redemption coordination and durable rate limits. Account erasure must revoke first and rotate generation.';
-- Grant only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE to the runtime role. Do not expose this table
-- through browser/public data APIs. Use a separate owner role for migration.
COMMIT;
